fix(panel): fix title missing panel background

 Fix `Panel` title missing the panel background style.

CHANGE: Change `yield from console.render(title_text, child_options.update_width(width - 4))` to `yield from console.render(title_text, child_options.update_width(width - 4), style=style)`.
